english.title: Driver of hackney carriage refuse to drive when requested by passenger
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), standing

(A)_[at a stand for hackney carriages appointed by the commissioners,]_
(B)_[in a street,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), refused or neglected, without reasonable excuse, to drive such carriage to a place

(C)_[within]_
(D)_[not exceeding]_

the prescribed distance, to which you were directed to drive by **(..SPECIFY HIRER..), the person hiring or wishing to hire that carriage
english.legislation: Contrary to section 53 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847.
